verses.translation: Lo! Man is in a state of loss;

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
verses.translation: save those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other to hold on to truth and counsel each other to be steadfast.
